description: Rejecting twin of p40: the same payload, with expected_digest computed over the canonical text encoded one byte per UTF-16 code unit, each truncated to its low eight bits. Those are the bytes Node's Buffer.from(text, "latin1") (alias "binary") produces, so this is the digest of a pipeline that hashes the canonical string through that encoding: 中 (U+4E2D) becomes 0x2d and 文 (U+6587) 0x87, and the value is lost. RFC 8785 section 3.2.4 requires UTF-8. An engine that hashes Latin-1 bytes rejects p39 to p42 and p14 and accepts this vector; one that accepts either encoding accepts this vector only.
